checked: Scatter direction uses output[map[source]], gains subsequently index destination.
Threshold distinction: direction >=0.5, bypass >0.5. Ordered queues consume last successful point, preserve prior state on failed point reads.
Zero frames consume parameters before audio descriptors. Bypass precedes silence skip. Silence skip leaves sample storage unchanged and propagates complete mask.
Corresponding alias detection stages all input planes before scatter; cross-channel and partial alias rejected. Bounds and pointer-end integer overflow checked before overlap arithmetic.
Exact source-derived f64 coefficients and pre-rounded f32 constants retained; f32 multiply remains f32. No fast-math or FMA contraction allowed.
Arithmetic domain lower 8*minimum-normal and upper max-finite/8 encloses all reviewed coefficient products within finite normal range; signed zero supported.
Error-state changes are staged and atomic. Candidate restricts descriptors, normalized parameters, silence validity and FP control more narrowly than unproven native error behavior.
Independent test oracle reads pinned source Mach-O tables and uses rational nearest-even conversion rather than candidate table parsing.
limitations: Source review supports only the declared restricted subset. No target runtime executed.
No VST3 host ABI, meters, arbitrary live configuration changes or full lifecycle parity claimed.
Wrapper and actual build still require their separate integration tests.
